skill.summary: Get ready-to-use prompts ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text description (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI, up to 500MB), say something like...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Prompt Generator Skill — generate video prompts instantly.

- Allows users to upload text descriptions or video files and receive ready-to-use 1080p MP4 video prompts.
- Handles authentication automatically, including free token acquisition and session management.
- Supports natural language commands for generating video prompts, exporting videos, checking credits, uploading files, and viewing status.
- Routes user requests to the appropriate action using keyword and intent classification.
- Provides clear feedback during connection, processing, and error handling.
- Batch uploads, iterative editing, and multiple file formats supported (including MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, images, and audio).
